Methodology & notes
Figures are aggregated directly from the source master workbook (Land_Parcel_Extent_Booked_Repor, 18,068 rows). "Extent" and "parcel" units are carried as recorded in the source without a stated unit of measure — treat cross-district comparisons as relative, not absolute, until the source unit is confirmed. Non-functional RSKs carry no booked land-parcel data by definition, so they contribute zero extent/parcels but are counted separately in the register at right. All totals recompute live as you drill — nothing below is pre-baked per view.
